description: This file contains test helper functions and setup routines for the Mattermost server, specifically for testing channels, posts, users, roles, and related components within the 'app' package.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to create and manage test data and environment for Mattermost server testing.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Initializes a test environment with configuration, store, logger, and server setup.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns a test license based on enterprise and configuration flags.

methods.name: setupStores
methods.description: Sets up database and search engine stores for testing.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Prepares a test environment with default options, skipping if in short mode.

methods.name: SetupConfig
methods.description: Prepares a test environment with custom configuration updates.

methods.name: SetupWithoutPreloadMigrations
methods.description: Sets up a test environment without preloading migrations.

methods.name: SetupWithStoreMock
methods.description: Sets up a test environment with a mocked store.

methods.name: SetupEnterpriseWithStoreMock
methods.description: Sets up an enterprise test environment with a mocked store.
